limits.sign: u32 compared signed (cmp/ge); values above 0x7FFFFFFF would be negative and never jump; no preset comes near
limits.quantize: jumps keep the beat count; with QUANTIZE on the landing point snaps to the grid (offset < half a beat, same for all pads)
limits.loop: while a loop is active the same pads are LOOP MOVE and use the same table: a preset changes loop-move sizes too (long: moved 4 and 16 beats)
limits.slip: with SLIP on the pad jump is momentary and returns when released, for stock and presets alike
limits.no_grid: a track with no rekordbox analysis still jumps (from its BPM tag), stock and presets alike
